description: Map UniProt cystinuria missense variants onto rBAT structural classes computed from 6LI9 SASA, and test class enrichment
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, mannwhitneyu
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
 'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(txt):
    L=txt.split('\n'); i=0
    while i<len(L):
        if L[i].startswith('loop_'):
            j=i+1; cols=[]
            while j<len(L) and L[j].strip().startswith('_'): cols.append(L[j].strip()); j+=1
            if cols and cols[0].startswith('_atom_site.'):
                nm=[c.split('.')[1] for c in cols]; k=j; out=[]
                while k<len(L) and L[k] and not L[k].startswith(('loop_','#','_')):
                    p=L[k].split()
                    if len(p)==len(nm): out.append(dict(zip(nm,p)))
                    k+=1
                return out
            i=j
        else: i+=1
    return []
at=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/6LI9.cif",timeout=180).text)
for a in at:
    a['xyz']=np.array([float(a['Cartn_x']),float(a['Cartn_y']),float(a['Cartn_z'])])
    a['rid']=int(a['auth_seq_id']) if a['auth_seq_id'].lstrip('-').isdigit() else -999
    a['ch']=a['auth_asym_id']
prot=[a for a in at if a['group_PDB']=='ATOM' and a['label_comp_id'] in AA3 and not a['label_atom_id'].startswith('H')]
A=[a for a in prot if a['ch']=='A']; seqA={a['rid']:AA3[a['label_comp_id']] for a in A if a['label_atom_id']=='CA'}

# --- SASA (Shrake-Rupley) for rBAT chain A: isolated vs in complex -> interface burial
VDW={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
n_sph=120; gr=(1+5**0.5)/2; k=np.arange(n_sph)
th=np.arccos(1-2*(k+.5)/n_sph); ph=2*np.pi*k/gr
sph=np.c_[np.sin(th)*np.cos(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(th)]
def sasa_of(target, context):
    P=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in context]); Rad=np.array([VDW.get(a['type_symbol'],1.7)+1.4 for a in context])
    tree=cKDTree(P); idx={id(a):i for i,a in enumerate(context)}
    out={}
    for a in target:
        i=idx[id(a)]; pts=P[i]+Rad[i]*sph
        nb=[j for j in tree.query_ball_point(P[i],Rad[i]+Rad.max()) if j!=i]
        free=np.ones(n_sph,bool)
        if nb:
            D=np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None,:]-P[nb][None,:,:],axis=2); free=(D>=Rad[nb][None,:]).all(1)
        out[a['rid']]=out.get(a['rid'],0)+4*np.pi*Rad[i]**2*free.mean()
    return out
MAXA={'A':129,'R':274,'N':195,'D':193,'C':167,'Q':225,'E':223,'G':104,'H':224,'I':197,'L':201,
      'K':236,'M':224,'F':240,'P':159,'S':155,'T':172,'W':285,'Y':263,'V':174}
s_iso=sasa_of(A,A)                                   # rBAT alone
s_AB =sasa_of(A,[a for a in prot if a['ch'] in 'AB']) # with its own b0,+AT
s_AC =sasa_of(A,[a for a in prot if a['ch'] in 'AC']) # with the partner rBAT
rsa={r:s_iso[r]/MAXA[seqA[r]] for r in s_iso if r in seqA}
d_lt={r:s_iso[r]-s_AB[r] for r in s_iso}   # buried by light subunit
d_sd={r:s_iso[r]-s_AC[r] for r in s_iso}   # buried by superdimer partner

CATAL={314,384,449}; LOST={312,448,174}; CA_SITE={214,318,319,321}; CSR={210,215}
def klass(r):
    if r in CATAL: return 'catalytic carboxylate'
    if r in CA_SITE: return 'Ca2+ site'
    if d_lt.get(r,0)>10: return 'b0,+AT interface'
    if d_sd.get(r,0)>10: return 'superdimer interface'
    if rsa.get(r,1)<0.20: return 'buried core'
    return 'exposed surface'
cls={r:klass(r) for r in seqA}
print("structural class counts over",len(cls),"modelled rBAT residues:")
print(pd.Series(cls).value_counts().to_string())

# --- UniProt natural variants (cystinuria) ---
j=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q07837.json",params={"fields":"ft_variant"},timeout=60).json()
var=[]
for f in j.get('features',[]):
    if f['type']!='Natural variant': continue
    pos=f['location']['start']['value']
    alt=f.get('alternativeSequence',{})
    o=alt.get('originalSequence'); n=(alt.get('alternativeSequences') or [None])[0]
    if not o or not n or len(n)!=1: continue   # missense only
    desc=f.get('description','')
    var.append({'pos':pos,'wt':o,'mut':n,'desc':desc,
                'disease':('CSNU' in desc or 'cystinuria' in desc.lower())})
V=pd.DataFrame(var)
print(f"\nUniProt Q07837 missense natural variants: {len(V)}  (disease-annotated: {V.disease.sum()})")
D=V[V.disease & V.pos.isin(seqA)].copy()
D['class']=[cls[p] for p in D.pos]
D['rsa']=[round(rsa[p],3) for p in D.pos]
print(f"disease missense variants modelled in 6LI9 chain A: {len(D)}")
print("\nclass distribution: disease variants vs all modelled residues")
bg=pd.Series(cls).value_counts(); fg=D['class'].value_counts()
rows=[]
for c in bg.index:
    a=int(fg.get(c,0)); b=len(D)-a; cc=int(bg[c])-a; dd=len(cls)-int(bg[c])-b
    orr,p=fisher_exact([[a,b],[cc,dd]])
    rows.append({'class':c,'n_variants':a,'pct_variants':100*a/len(D),'n_residues':int(bg[c]),
                 'pct_residues':100*bg[c]/len(cls),'OR':round(orr,2) if np.isfinite(orr) else np.inf,'p':p})
T=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('p')
print(T.to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:f"{x:.3g}"))

print("\nCatalytic / lost-subsite positions vs disease variants:")
for r,lab in [(314,'nucleophile D314'),(384,'acid/base E384'),(449,'TS-stab D449'),
              (312,'S312 (lost Arg)'),(448,'P448 (lost His)'),(174,'R174 (pocket plug)'),
              (214,'N214 Ca2+'),(215,'H215 CSR-I'),(210,'D210 CSR-I'),(321,'E321 Ca2+')]:
    hit=D[D.pos==r]
    print(f"  {lab:22s} RSA={rsa.get(r,float('nan')):.2f} class={cls.get(r,'-'):22s} "
          f"disease variants: {'; '.join(hit.wt+str(r)+hit.mut) if len(hit) else 'none'}")

# nearest disease variant to each catalytic residue (3D)
CA={a['rid']:a['xyz'] for a in A if a['label_atom_id']=='CA'}
print("\nDistance from each catalytic carboxylate to the nearest disease-variant residue (CA-CA):")
for r in sorted(CATAL):
    d=sorted(((np.linalg.norm(CA[r]-CA[p]),p) for p in D.pos if p in CA))
    print(f"  {seqA[r]}{r}: nearest = {seqA[d[0][1]]}{d[0][1]} at {d[0][0]:.1f} A")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
order=['buried core','b0,+AT interface','superdimer interface','exposed surface','Ca2+ site','catalytic carboxylate']
x=np.arange(len(order)); w=0.38
ax[0].bar(x-w/2,[100*bg.get(c,0)/len(cls) for c in order],w,label='all rBAT residues',color='#9bb7d4')
ax[0].bar(x+w/2,[100*fg.get(c,0)/len(D) for c in order],w,label=f'cystinuria missense (n={len(D)})',color='#c0392b')
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels([c.replace(' ','\n') for c in order],fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel('percent of residues'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title('Cystinuria variants concentrate in the buried core,\nnot at the GH13 catalytic positions',fontsize=10)
for i,c in enumerate(order):
    pv=float(T[T['class']==c].p.iloc[0]); 
    if pv<0.05: ax[0].text(i,max(100*bg.get(c,0)/len(cls),100*fg.get(c,0)/len(D))+1,f"p={pv:.1e}",ha='center',fontsize=7)

gh=['CSR-I\nD98','CSR-I His\nH103','CSR-II Arg\nR197','nucleophile\nD199','acid/base\nE255','CSR-IV His\nH328','TS-stab\nD329']
rbat=[1,1,0,1,1,0,1]; f2=[0,0,0,0,0,0,0]
ax[1].bar(np.arange(7)-0.2,rbat,0.4,color='#27ae60',label='rBAT (SLC3A1)')
ax[1].bar(np.arange(7)+0.2,f2,0.4,color='#7f8c8d',label='4F2hc (SLC3A2)')
ax[1].set_xticks(np.arange(7)); ax[1].set_xticklabels(gh,fontsize=7)
ax[1].set_yticks([0,1]); ax[1].set_yticklabels(['lost','retained'])
ax[1].set_title('GH13 functional positions retained after 3D superposition\nonto oligo-1,6-glucosidase (1UOK)',fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,loc='center right')
for i,(r_,lbl) in enumerate(zip(rbat,['D210','H215','S312','D314','E384','P448','D449'])):
    ax[1].text(i-0.2,r_+0.03,lbl,ha='center',fontsize=7,color='#27ae60' if r_ else '#c0392b')
for i,lbl in enumerate(['A277','N215','I287','T279','S282','S333','L334']):
    ax[1].text(i+0.2,0.03,lbl,ha='center',fontsize=7,color='#7f8c8d')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
